artifact.description: Velociraptor artifact and optional source name, e.g. Windows.Network.NetstatEnriched/Netstat.

client-id.description: Velociraptor client identifier, scoped to the originating server.

collected-at.description: Explicit collection time with a timezone. This is not the occurrence time of the observed activity.

flow-id.description: Velociraptor flow or collection identifier, scoped to the originating server/client.

hostname.description: Reported endpoint hostname or FQDN, retained as context rather than a network indicator.

hunt-id.description: Velociraptor hunt identifier, scoped to the originating server.

parser-version.description: Name/version of the importer that produced the normalized observation.

row.description: JSON representation of the result row, including unmapped fields. Keep the original export for exact bytes and numeric precision.

row-number.description: One-based ordinal of the record in the source export; CSV headers and blank JSONL lines are excluded.

server-id.description: Identifier of the originating Velociraptor server or deployment, supplied by the analyst or export metadata.

source-format.description: Encoding of the source export: json, jsonl or csv.

source-sha256.description: SHA-256 of the original export bytes. The source file object points to this result row using derived-from.

description: A Velociraptor artifact result row with collection provenance and original row context. Link to the source export and to derived process, file, network-socket or service objects. An observation does not by itself establish malicious activity.
name: velociraptor-result
